oneOf.description: Read built-in effects and cached native AU/VST3 plugins. Use format Built-in for immediate scan-free discovery; AU/VST3 filter the installed inventory. Rescan refreshes external plugins only.

Shared pattern tools, one document undo action; selection/channel/pattern/song scope. Song visits every allocated pattern once, including unused patterns. Up to 262144 selected cells. Dry runs return first 512 changed cells plus the full count. Volume/effect masks move command and value together. Numeric targets default to existing values. Exponential endpoints must be positive. Expand/shrink reject lost fields unless allowDataLoss is true. insertRows/deleteRows shift only masked fields within each fixed region; amount is 1..region rows. Insertion protects discarded tail fields, deletion protects removed leading fields, unless allowDataLoss is true. Pattern envelopes do not move.

oneOf.description: Read stable order identities and named section ranges for the active sequence.

oneOf.description: Read native audio bus indices, names, channel layouts, support and activation without opening the plugin UI.

Replace sources feeding one auxiliary effect input. Input must be enabled for nonempty sources. Sources sum with insert-position delay compensation; pre/post taps honor source mute/solo. Empty sources removes even dormant/unavailable routes. One document Undo; routing changes stop playback.
